fonts.display: 'bogue-black', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Oat Cream
palette.role: Secondary surface — feature card backgrounds, warm button fills, tag backgrounds

palette.name: Morning Fog
palette.role: Page canvas, subtle borders, hairline dividers — the base everything sits on

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Primary text, dark filled buttons, dark icon fills

palette.name: Sticker Black
palette.role: Heavy borders on cards, images, and the logo wordmark — the signature outline that makes elements feel cut from paper

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Card surfaces above the cream canvas, text on dark buttons, input field fills

palette.name: Kofi Blue
palette.role: Blue wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Cobalt Pop
palette.role: Primary action hover/pressed state, saturated Kofi Blue variant
